title: Actual K=12 global Lipschitz-margin baseline capability

scientific_dispositions.H06_global_lipschitz_conservatism: Global Lipschitz constants (~500) cause certified Euclidean radii to collapse to <= 1e-3.
scientific_dispositions.H19_vanishing_coverage: Displacements on continuous sensor streams (~0.5-2.0) drastically exceed certified radius (~0.004), yielding 0% singleton reuse.
scientific_dispositions.H21_rejection_of_gap_constants: GAP model constants (L ~ 10) do not apply to SmallCNN1D with dense projection (L ~ 500).
scientific_dispositions.H22_conditional_status: Lipschitz spectral bounds are computed in real arithmetic and tagged CONDITIONAL_REAL_ARITHMETIC.
